subject: Computação
description_pt: Construir soluções computacionais de problemas de diferentes áreas do conhecimento, de forma individual e colaborativa, selecionando as estruturas de dados e técnicas adequadas, aperfeiçoando e articulando saberes escolares. Construir e analisar soluções computacionais de problemas de diferentes áreas do conhecimento de forma individual ou colaborativa selecionando as estruturas de dados adequadas (registros, matrizes, listas e grafos), aperfeiçoando e articulando saberes escolares.

components.description_pt: Selecionar estruturas de dados apropriadas (registros, arrays, listas ou grafos) para problema computacional
components.description_en: Select appropriate data structures (records, arrays, lists, or graphs) for a given computational problem
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate mathematical or computational tools to model a specific phenomenon

components.description_pt: Construir uma solução computacional para problema interdisciplinar usando estruturas de dados escolhidas
components.description_en: Construct a computational solution to a cross-disciplinary problem using chosen data structures
components.cc_component_description: Construct a mathematical or computational model to represent relationships within a system

components.description_pt: Analisar eficiência e correção de uma solução computacional para um problema dado
components.description_en: Analyze the efficiency and correctness of a computational solution to a given problem
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the accuracy of a computational model by analyzing discrepancies between predicted and actual outcomes

components.description_pt: Refinar uma solução computacional integrando conhecimentos de outras áreas de disciplinas escolares
components.description_en: Refine a computational solution by integrating knowledge from other school subject areas
components.cc_component_description: Refine a proposed solution based on evaluation results and new evidence

cc_matches.description: Use mathematical, computational, and/or algorithmic representations of phenomena or design solutions to describe and/or support claims and/or explanations.
Develop and/or use a model (including mathematical and computational) to generate data to support explanations, predict phenomena, analyze systems, and/or solve problems.
Create and/or revise a computational model or simulation of a phenomenon, designed device, process, or system.
Design, evaluate, and/or refine a solution to a complex real-world problem, based on scientific knowledge, student-generated sources of evidence, prioritized criteria, and tradeoff considerations.
